### `Compiler`

<a id="Compiler.call_in_order"></a>
#### Compiler.call_in_order

`List Compiler.call_in_order(Compiler c, List callee, List arguments)`

Calls the typed callable `callee` with `arguments`, each converted to
its parameter and evaluated once, in source order, as a statement
expression.

Source: `src/transform/literals.x:225`

<a id="Compiler.lower_lambda_expr"></a>
#### Compiler.lower_lambda_expr

`List Compiler.lower_lambda_expr(Compiler c, List expression)`

Lowers a resolved lambda expression, under any position wrappers and
parentheses, through the lambda rule of
`src/components/lambda-functions.x`;
other expressions pass through. A noncapturing lambda typed `Func`,
which only a meta body leaves unlifted, lifts to a `Func` of its native
signature.

Source: `src/transform/expressions.x:9`

<a id="Compiler.normalize"></a>
#### Compiler.normalize

`Ast Compiler.normalize(Compiler c, Ast ast)`

Normalizes one bound and typed node. Newly constructed syntax is
normalized where it is produced; children enter the same operation, so
completed units do not require another unit walk.

Source: `src/transform/traversal.x:33`

<a id="Compiler.pack_rest_arguments"></a>
#### Compiler.pack_rest_arguments

`List Compiler.pack_rest_arguments(Compiler c, List params, List args)`

Preserves the fixed arguments for `params`, which ends in `(....)`, and
packs the remaining `args` through ordinary List construction. Only an
explicit splice contributes more than one element. The caller changes
the callee's final parameter to List before issuing this packed call.

Source: `src/transform/expressions.x:354`

<a id="Compiler.shipped_support"></a>
#### Compiler.shipped_support

`void Compiler.shipped_support( Compiler c, Symbol kind, List source, String form)`

Adds to the unit's pending support the file-scope code a rule gives
the form `source` of `kind`, bound and lowered with the support. The
kernel has no lowering of its own for `source`, so no rule ends the
translation as `_shipped_lowering` does.

Source: `src/transform/traversal.x:121`

<a id="Compiler.transform"></a>
#### Compiler.transform

`List Compiler.transform(Compiler c, List ast)`

Lowers a bound and typed top-level AST to the normalized form consumed by
emission. `c` must own the AST's bindings, origins, and conversion
state. Current-node rewrites finish before child traversal; containing
blocks absorb cleanup markers produced by declaration rewrites. Pending
support declarations are lowered and appended after the input units. Their
storage determines their interface visibility. The call may add
generated origins or diagnostics to `c`.

Source: `src/transform/traversal.x:13`

## Design notes

Lowers typed expressions, literals, and statements into the AST forms
consumed by C emission. One recursive normalizer rewrites each node
where it is produced, and children enter the same operation, so a unit
is walked once. `callables.x` lowers the `Func` conversions it meets,
shipped components lower the forms the kernel no longer lowers, and
`cleanup.x` lowers each completed function's cleanup regions. The
active Compiler reports errors.
